text:
Rae: real quick \/ thought: sampled logs + redaction are making it impossible to correlate an incident across sampled traces. proposing a deterministic tenant-scoped "fieldline" id for sensitive fields so we can join without keeping raw PII.
Diego: sounds useful. is this just another salted hash?
Rae: similar but tenant-KMS-backed HMAC, and designed with replay UX: we store field_id alongside redacted value and synthesize deterministic surrogates for replay.
Anita: can you show a tiny example?
Rae: ```
// on ingest
field_id = HMAC_SHA256(tenant_kms_key_v1, utf8(field_value))
store: { email: "[redacted]", field_id: "d34f..." }
// for replay: surrogate = synth(field_id, schema=email)
```
Charlie: replays with surrogates = OK for most bugs but ops/legal will need a path to see originals.
Rae: agreed. breakglass path: ticket + 2 approvers + ephemeral KMS decrypt logged immutably. default: no raw PII in day-to-day debugging.
Diego: how does this play with sampling? if we sample 0.5% of requests, will field_id help join metrics?
Rae: yes. small hex ids are cheap join keys across ES/TSDB. helps link sampled logs/traces to the same logical entity.
Anita: attachments and embeddings? we can't store full ids for huge blobs.
Rae: for attachments use chunked fingerprints (SHA256 chunks) and store compact fingerprints array. for embeddings, record hashed-span ids for extracted spans. fingerprints only, no content.
Charlie: what about GDPR right-to-be-forgotten? HMAC is irreversible; tenant asks to delete value 12 how do we find and remove occurrences?
Rae: we'll tag logs with key-version. deletion flow: rotate tenant key, scrub logs per retention & legal flags, and mark residual references as deleted in metadata. legal team will own edgecases.
Anita: perf impact? computing HMAC per sensitive field at ingress might add CPU. we should prototype middleware and bench.
Diego: agree. also surrogate generator must be cheap and deterministic. even simple PRNG seeded by field_id is ok.
Rae: proposed rollout:
1) telemetry-only: emit field_id + redact (no console change) 12 10 days
2) console canary: show field_id + "Preview surrogate" action for selected tenants 12 2 weeks
3) debug routing: opt-in small debug pool (no sampling) + X-Debug-Mode header + per-tenant quotas/billing tags 12 3 weeks
4) enterprise unredact: breakglass + 2-approver ephemeral decrypt (contracted feature) 12 6 weeks
Charlie: routing detail: add header X-RI-Debug: route=debug-pool. middleware should drop header downstream unless explicitly allowed. devs opt-in per-tenant.
Anita: console UX: show redacted value, field_id badge, and a watermarked surrogate modal. include an "Explain surrogate" tooltip. avoid implying it's original data.
Diego: metrics to watch: surrogate confusion tickets, collision alerts (same id but different field-type), debug-pool overuse, unredact requests.
Rae: collisions extremely unlikely with HMAC_SHA256, but we'll add a monitor alert if same id maps to differing hashed prefixes/field-types.
LegalBot: flagging: @legal-team please review deletion semantics and contractual implications for enterprise unredact.
OpsBot: feature-flag: "fieldline_debug_routing" created on eng-platform.
Charlie: runbook 12 when unredact requested: require ticket id, 2 approvers (legal + sec), ephemeral KMS key minted with 1h TTL, and immutable audit entry containing who/unboxed/why.
Anita: SDK/Devex: provide client middleware to opt-in X-RI-Debug and sample snippet for surrogate generation so teams can test locally. docs and support blurb required.
Diego: billing: debug pool should be metered separately; finance wants cap estimates. include rough upper bound in RFC.
Rae: I'll build a prototype middleware, a console mock, and an RFC with perf & cost estimates. PR soon.
Charlie: +1 12 please include a canary kill-switch and per-tenant feature flag.
Rae: will do. opening RFC after prototype.
OpsBot: ticket RFC-1754444444-fieldline-debug-routing opened (https:\/\/r.ticket\/1754444444) :white_check_mark:
Anita: adding a short support-facing blurb explaining "surrogate" and unredact flow.
Diego: thanks 12 will validate join behavior on staging once PR lands.
Rae: end.
